text:
Leah M: Sharing the final blog draft + two email hero variants for an A/B test. Need legal quick-pass, confirm HubSpot routing, and press embargo list. Target publish Thu 10am PT.

Leah M: MAILER SUBJECT:

Variant A: "Redwood Inference: predictable inference for production teams (webinar + try)"
Variant B: "Ship LLM features faster: Redwood Inference launch + webinar"

Leah M: HERO COPY OPTIONS:
- A: "Built for engineers: predictable latency and clearer unit economics."
- B: "Ship production LLMs with predictable latency and fewer surprises."

Leah M: Primary CTA -> https://redwood.com/signup?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_dec2026&utm_medium=mailer&utm_variant=A
Secondary CTA -> https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_dec2026&utm_medium=mailer&utm_variant=A
Hidden field suggestion: launch_batch=dec2026_abtest

Omar H: Love the variants. Ops: HubSpot form created: "Launch Trial Dec2026". Workflow: "Launch Trial Routing Dec2026" -> Queue: launch-dec26-sdr. Webhook for registrants: https://hooks.redwood.com/webinar/dec is live. Hidden field implemented: launch_batch=dec2026_abtest. hs-ops: UTMs validated.

June P: From product: please avoid absolute percent language in hero. If we show comparative numbers put them only in the benchmark section with a methodology link to /bench/dec2026-methods. Also add a short boxed callout in the blog explaining dataset types used in bench.

Riley S: Press teaser for embargo list (90w):

"Redwood Inference launches a production-focused inference platform that combines intelligent batching, KV caching, and smart routing to help engineering teams run LLMs with more consistent latency and clearer unit economics. The platform supports hosted, dedicated, and private deployments and includes rollout controls and per-route observability. Join the launch webinar for benchmarks and demos."

Leah M: Press wire blurb (~160w):
"Redwood Inference today unveils a developer-first inference platform offering hosted, dedicated, and private deployment modes with a GPU-optimized serving runtime and workload-aware optimizations. The product provides smart routing, KV caching, and model lifecycle controls to reduce variability and improve predictability for production LLMs. Engineers get per-route observability, canary rollouts, and cost controls to simplify rollouts. The company will host a launch webinar with benchmark walkthroughs and a product demo. More at https://redwood.com/press"

legal-bot: Automated quick-pass: copy OK. Condition: any numeric or comparative performance claims must be confined to the benchmark section with a methods link and reproducible notes. Avoid standalone savings percentages in hero/email.

Omar H: Confirmed webhook payload includes hidden field and utm_variant so SDRs can split test owners. I created two HubSpot lists: "Launch Trial - Variant A" and "Variant B" for performance tracking.

June P: Also request social snippets for both variants and a short LinkedIn hero (<=240 chars) + X (<=140). I'll provide the CTO quote for the meta image: "We built Redwood Inference so teams can ship and scale inference with predictable economics."

Riley S: Press CSV ready. Holding embargo until publish time. I also prepared a 50-word teaser for top-tier outlets.

Leah M: Final checklist before lock: blog body (bench section + methods link), meta image (1200x630) with CTO quote, A/B email variants, CTAs+UTMs (variant tags), HubSpot form + hidden fields, webhook, press CSV, localization plan for EU/APAC, and scheduled social snippets. Can someone confirm localization plan and quick legal re-check?

Omar H: Localization plan: EU and APAC CTAs will point to regional subdomains with utm_region param. I've added an automation to tag region from recipient IP when possible.

legal-bot: Quick re-check complete. Approve final assets pending no standalone numeric claims outside benchmark section.

June P: I'll sign off on meta image and social snippets by EOD. Good to lock publish Thu 10am PT.

Leah M: Locking publish window Thu 10am PT. Posting final assets here shortly and will ping channel at publish time. Thanks everyone! :tada:
